subject: Signature platform sourcing & rollout roadmap
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Signature platform sourcing & rollout roadmap

Hi team,

I'm starting a short sourcing sprint for our signature platform (renewal window/contract triggers coming up in Q2 2027). Objective: pick a primary e-sign provider + a fall-back vendor, finalize pricing guardrails, and produce a 90-day rollout plan for Legal/CS to onboard contracts and templates.

Quick constraints to keep in mind:
- Must support tenant-level audit logs and customer-managed KMS (security ask)
- API-first integrations: bulk envelope creation, webhook reliability under spike load
- Support for advanced signer workflows (embedded signing, recipient routing)
- Prefer vendors with SOC 2 + ISO 27001 and a clear on-premise/export compliance path

I've attached a first-pass requirements doc (signature-requirements-v1.pdf). Please reply with vendor shortlist + 1 pager on why they're a fit by EOD Mon (Nov 30). I'll schedule a 30 min sync after we have the shortlist.

Thanks — Marcus
VP, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Signature platform sourcing & rollout roadmap

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 08:45 Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'm starting a short sourcing sprint for our signature platform ...

Thanks Marcus — attached is a vendor-scorecard (vendor-scorecard-20261201.csv) with a quick pass at Ironclad, DocuSign, Adobe Sign, and OneSpan. High-level notes:
- Ironclad: best CLM + embedded signing experience; pricing a bit higher but strong contract automation.
- DocuSign: broadest market support and integrations; good for external customers with multi-jurisdiction trust.
- Adobe Sign: competitive on price, lighter on audit log features we need.
- OneSpan: strong for regulated finance customers but heavier setup.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ask procurement to run a quick compliance checklist (SOC2, encryption at rest, KMS) for top 2 vendors.
2) Legal (Markus/Laura) to draft an acceptable baseline SOW and data processing addendum we can use in negotiations.
3) Schedule vendor calls this week — prioritize Ironclad + DocuSign.

I'll coordinate vendor availability and loop in Procurement Ops.

— Marissa
Senior Manager, Procurement
From: Procurement Ops <procurement@vendorservices.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Signature platform sourcing & rollout roadmap

Hi Marissa / Marcus,

We ran the baseline compliance checks you requested. Summary (high level):
- Ironclad: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, supports BYOK via KMS integrations.
- DocuSign: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, strong global certifications; BYOK available for enterprise tiers.
- Adobe Sign: SOC 2 Type II; BYOK limited in standard plans.

We'll prepare the full evidence pack (encrypted link) for Legal. Expect the packet by EOD Thu (Dec 3).

Procurement Ops
From: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@ironclad.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jane.patel@docusign.com
Date: 2026-12-03T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: Signature platform evaluation — Ironclad follow-up

Marcus / Marissa — thanks for the invite and for sharing requirements. Attaching a short SOW draft we typically use with platform customers (Ironclad-SOW-draft.pdf).

High level proposal:
- 90-day pilot: access to full API + CLM features, sandbox with sample KMS integration, support for template migration.
- Pricing: tiered usage + per-user admin seat; we can commit to 99.9% API uptime SLA on enterprise plans.
- Integration support: 2 onboarding sessions + a dedicated solutions engineer for the pilot.

We're available for a 45 min technical call on Fri (Dec 4) or Mon (Dec 7). Happy to include our security lead to walk through audit logs and KMS workflow.

Best,
Kevin Liu
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Ironclad
Attachment: Ironclad-SOW-draft.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Signature platform sourcing & rollout roadmap

Thanks everyone — good momentum. Quick decisions / asks before the vendor calls:
- Markus/Laura: please share the baseline SOW language and the minimum DPA terms we will not compromise on (encryption, subprocessor notice, breach SLA) by EOD Tue (Dec 8). That will let Procurement anchor negotiations.
- Marissa: book vendor technical calls: prioritize Ironclad Fri Dec 4 (confirm), DocuSign Mon Dec 7. Add a 30-min alignment call for Product & Security after each demo.
- Procurement Ops: when you send the evidence pack, include uptime history and recent pen-test summaries.

Goal: agree on pilot vendor and contractual guardrails by Dec 15 so Legal can start redlining. If all looks good, we plan a phased migration starting Mar 2027 (templates + automated routing).

I'll prepare a short one-pager for execs summarizing recommended vendor + cost delta after the two demos.

— Marcus
VP, Platform Partnerships
